source_merge.policy: No cross-branch merge, cherry-pick or rewrite of an owner branch in this milestone. The manifest records pins and conflicts; composition is a later, separately authorized step.

conflict_audit.conclusion: Siblings from merge-base 008a3360 (#200 head). Their own-commit surfaces are 22 and 13 files with an empty intersection; 163 files shared in the net sets are inherited ancestry, not collision.
The safety line is file-disjoint from the Fleet and Core lanes. Semantic coupling remains: #241 edits fleet/agent-control-contract.yaml while F1 adds fleet/fleet-mcp-contract.yaml.
